# Input Search

```tsx
import { InputSearch } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

A search field built on Input Text. Mirrors the Figma Input Search component: State (Default / Hover / Active / Disabled / Read Only) × Filled.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<div className="grid w-fit grid-cols-2 gap-x-10 gap-y-8">
  <InputSearch className="w-60" placeholder="Buscar" />
  <InputSearch className="w-60" placeholder="Buscar" disabled />
  <InputSearch className="w-60" defaultValue="Value" />
  <InputSearch className="w-60" defaultValue="Value" readOnly />
</div>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Input Search component: Input Text with the Search icon, no label and no error state. The browser's own clear button is hidden so only Button Clear shows.

## Types

`InputSearchProps`

## Rules

- Import `InputSearch` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
